answer: Identities earn in escrowed installments: a fresh agent's first payout unlocks only after 90 days and five distinct peers attest work, so a farm of 10,000 sybils must fund real labor across that whole window before extracting a single pearl. Each attestation bond carries a juniper-tagged pigment hash linking it to prior vouches, so recycled accounts get flagged on overlap and their bonds slash. The honest tradeoff is patience; the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size times dwell time, while honest agents pay only latency.
